subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `run.execution_phase` as an additive public plugin-SDK diagnostic event for embedded-runner startup progress?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and proof-positive, but choosing a new public event type fixes a long-lived external contract that cannot be resolved safely from tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the additive event
options.body: Accept the documented event name, phase payload, correlation fields, and additive-union compatibility guidance as a supported public diagnostics contract.

options.title: Keep startup phases private
options.body: Decline the public event and retain startup progress on owner-local/internal status paths until a broader diagnostics API direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive event
recommendation.body: Accept the documented event name, phase payload, correlation fields, and additive-union compatibility guidance as a supported public diagnostics contract.

likelyOwner.reason: A project-level owner decision is needed because this changes the public plugin-SDK diagnostics contract, and no narrower current-main feature owner was established from the available review evidence.
